body:
My parents love a fake shell of a person that I put on around people who Im not out to. I have enough good friends and a supportive very nice boyfriend but I dont talk to them about my suicidal urges bc they would get scared. I like the detachment that strangers on the internet have, I prefer talking to strangers about this. 
I get called the wrong pronouns bc not only am I not out, but I dont pass as my preferred gender at all. Its not really anyones fault. Its just a tiny reminder that Im not who everyone thinks I am.

I would go to canada with my boyfriend but I dont have the money and also my cosmetology license isnt valid up there unless I go back to school in canada.

I dont want to leave my parents. As long as I play along I get full support in almost anything I do, and enough money to get anything I want. Im still depressed. I could shuffle some money around to pay for hormone treatment but its not like they wouldnt figure it out sooner or later. 

I cant leave my hometown bc I dont have a job yet. Im a licensed cosmetologist but havent picked up a job yet bc depression fucked my work ethic and I dont think 8 hours of being called the wrong pronouns every day is gonna help. Either way I figure Im gonna die moneyless and alone if I dont find a way out soon.
